chunks: What Jamil narrated from Zurarah, from one of the two of them عليهما السلام, who said:

I asked him about a man who led a people in two rak'ahs, then informed them that he was not in a state of wudu (ablution). He said: The people complete their salat (prayer), for there is no liability upon the Imam.

key_terms.الْإِمَامِ: the prayer leader in congregational salat
key_terms.الْقَوْمُ: the people praying behind the Imam
key_terms.ضَمَانٌ: liability or responsibility borne for the validity of others' prayer
key_terms.وُضُوءٍ: ritual ablution required for the validity of salat (prayer)
key_terms.يُتِمُّ: completes or finishes what remains of the act

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if the Imam led the prayer and then realized he did not have wudu (ablution)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning congregational salat (prayer) when the Imam discovers that he lacked wudu (ablution) after leading part of the prayer. It states that the followers complete their salat, and that there is no liability upon the Imam in this matter.
